result.summary: Fixed 5 instances of PostgreSQL ON CONFLICT syntax errors in test fixtures that were preventing instance_projections rows from being created during test setup. Root cause: `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` syntax requires column specification (e.g., `ON CONFLICT (instance_id) DO NOTHING`). Fixed instances: (1) insertInstance() helper in event_store_integration_test.zig, (2) retention policy insert in event_store_integration_test.zig, (3) TC-DB-03-01 setup in db_integration_test.zig, (4) unit test insertInstance() in event_store_test.zig, (5) unit test insertInstance() in db_test.zig. All changes compiled successfully. Unit tests pass (540+ passing). Integration test execution pending for final verification.
